items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I found octave up there. Octave was playing piano up there... George McCollum, trumpet... Henry Jury playing saxophone... And, of course, they changed, changing a few men... little Lester Santiago. Oh yeah. He took, uh, Octave's place up there on piano.

ctx.x: Dave DePass you say was the clarinet player?

Clarinet player, yeah. Now his other half brothers was Rudolf Bollier and Octave, Octave, a fair few old people say I pronounce it Octave Bollier. Well after leaving René's band, then I went and played with Sam Morgan's band.
Ask a little bit more about René's band, who his clarinet player was? Could you tell us?
